scientific_intent.scientific_task: Price European call and put options using the analytic Black-Scholes engine with continuous dividend yield.
scientific_intent.mathematical_operation: Discounted normal-CDF formula with log spot/strike, scaled volatility, expiry and risk/dividend rates.
scientific_intent.discretization_or_topology: Independent option records; analytic stochastic-model solution rather than a discretized PDE or Monte Carlo simulation.
invariants: Option prices are nonnegative in the fixture.
Call-put parity and discounted payoff limits characterize the formula; no new market-model validation is implied.
accuracy_requirements: Every finite Float32 price must match an independent Float64 libm-erf analytic oracle and both GPU references within absolute 1e-4.
This matches native per-option tolerance and strengthens the inherited Julia subset-only 1e-3 check.
scientific_intent.precision_sensitivity: Cancellation near out-of-money prices; exp/log/erf approximations and discount evaluation change low bits. Measured absolute tolerance does not establish acceptable financial model error.
scientific_intent.input_size_regimes: 262144 independent options cycling all 37 exact source settings; all option input fields rounded once to Float32.
scientific_intent.community_use_case: Native source explicitly identifies a Quantlib-derived analytic Black-Scholes pricing engine.
